title: Waiting For Love
lyrics:
[00:07.00]Where there's a will, there's a way, kind of beautiful
[00:10.86]And every night has its day, so magical
[00:14.55]And if there's love in this life, there's no obstacle
[00:18.52]That can't be defeated
[00:22.00]For every tyrant, a tear for the vulnerable
[00:25.85]In every lost soul, the bones of a miracle
[00:29.51]For every dreamer, a dream we're unstoppable
[00:33.53]With something to believe in
[00:37.75]Monday left me broken
[00:40.50]Tuesday, I was through with hoping
[00:44.24]Wednesday, my empty arms were open
[00:48.04]Thursday, waiting for love, waiting for love
[00:52.70]Thank the stars it's Friday
[00:55.38]I'm burning like a fire gone wild on Saturday
[00:59.28]Guess I won't be coming to church on Sunday
[01:03.03]I'll be waiting for love, waiting for love
[01:07.48]To come around
[01:59.70]We are one of a kind, irreplaceable
[02:03.54]How did I get so blind and so cynical?
[02:07.32]If there's love in this life, we're unstoppable
[02:10.80]No, we can't be defeated
[02:15.20]Monday left me broken
[02:18.01]Tuesday, I was through with hoping
[02:21.78]Wednesday, my empty arms were open
[02:25.55]Thursday, waiting for love, waiting for love
[02:30.16]Thank the stars it's Friday
[02:32.79]I'm burning like a fire gone wild on Saturday
[02:36.82]Guess I won't be coming to church on Sunday
[02:40.50]I'll be waiting for love, waiting for love
[02:44.95]To come around
